text:
maya: quick sync 18: prepping a warmup+pin for runtime v3.2.2 during the early-morning window. This is a cross-service cutover: runtime, api feature flags, router header partition, console schema migration. Need regional sequencing and a shadow-warmup step.
ev: spelling out plan: shadow 15% synchronous traffic to new runtime for 15m, then canary 5% production, then 25% -> 100%. We do EU -> US -> APAC waves.
leo: curious about cache preheat: suggest issuing warmup queries via shadow traffic and enabling runtime.prefill=true to populate KV hot-keys.
rachel: console schema is backwards compatible but we must enforce validator fail-open for the canary so old clients don't hard-fail. If validator hits >1% schema-errors in canary -> abort.
maya: agreed. Rollback triggers: total 5xxs >3% sustained for 5m OR token-generation latency p50 >300ms delta for 10m OR schema-errors >1% in canary.
deploy-bot: @channel deploy plan generated: id /deploy/1907. Phases: shadow 15% (8065432200) -> canary 5% (8065432300) -> ramp 25% (8065432400) -> full 100% (8065432500). Pins: runtime:v3.2.2, api:feature=token-streaming-v2:on, router:partition=headers-v2, console:schema:v2.5. See /dash/release/1907.
ev: region windows: EU wave start 01:00 UTC, US 02:00 UTC, APAC 03:00 UTC. Each wave has its own shadow+canary sequence.
leo: adding ops-config diff: 
```yaml
runtime:
  max_batch_ms: 6
  prefill_kv: true
  kv_ttl_sec: 900
  canary_warm: true
```
ops-oncall: confirm drain: we'll soft-drain old runtime instances for 8m prior to shadow start; force-evict only if eviction-lag >60s.
maya: drain windows set in the plan. Also adding health-check gate: rollback_api endpoint must return 200 within 500ms for health to continue.
rachel: quick smoke checklist (short):
- shadow logs show successful prefill hits >80%
- api error rate <0.4%
- router drop rate <0.05%
- console validator errors <1%
- no GPU OOMs reported
ev: preflight dry-run 45m prior in staging at 00:15 UTC. I'll post artifacts.
deploy-bot: dry-run completed: /dash/releases/1907-dryrun. Key note: prefill_kv warmed top 200 keys, p95 token latency improved by 15ms in staging.
leo: adding automated throttle rule: if any rollback trigger observed, deploy-bot will throttle to 0% in that region and notify #incidents and ops-oncall.
maya: good. Also adding manual abort procedure: run `/deploy abort --id 1907 --region EU` then `/feature toggle set api token-streaming-v2 off` and `/router flag set partition headers-v2 off`
rachel: logging note: console will emit deprecation header `x-console-schema:v2.5` during canary. Ops should watch `validator.errors` metric.
ev: starting EU wave shadow at 01:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: EU shadow started 01:00 UTC -> 15% shadowing. Monitor: /dash/releases/1907-eu-shadow
ops-oncall: initial metrics: shadow p50 ok, small p95 bump +35ms, within target. no evictions.
leo: prefill shows kv_hitrate 0.82 after 10m, good. proceed to canary?
maya: wait 5m for stability check.
ops-oncall: stability check pass at 01:16 UTC. proceeding to EU canary 5%.
deploy-bot: EU canary 5% started at 01:20 UTC.
rachel: console validator reported 2/200 schema warnings (1%) 50 borderline. Keep monitoring, don't abort yet.
ev: api error rate 0.3% during canary. router drops 0.02%.
maya: proceed EU ramp to 25% at 01:30.
deploy-bot: EU ramp -> 25% at 01:30. router partition staged across 30% of edge nodes.
ops-oncall: small CPU spike on a subset of nodes, autoscaler handled it. p95 stable after 8m.
leo: proceeding to 100% EU at 01:45 if no regressions.
deploy-bot: EU full roll at 01:45 -> complete. Pins updated for EU.
maya: starting US wave with same sequence now.
ops-oncall: note: in US shadow we saw a transient 5xx burst (1.8%) for 2m tied to a backend timeout; deploy-bot throttled to 0% automatically and alerted.
deploy-bot: automatic throttle triggered for US shadow at 02:05 UTC. Rollback actions initiated: force traffic back to previous runtime variant and disable router partition in US gate.
ev: investigating root cause: backend DNS flapping in region-us-az2. Ops are routing around the AZ and recovering.
maya: good catch. Hold US wave until backend stable. Re-schedule US shadow to 02:25 UTC.
rachel: recording in release notes: "US wave auto-throttled due to transient backend timeouts; re-run scheduled 02:25 UTC. No consumer impact beyond canaries."
leo: after AZ reroute, run a focused prefill smoke with top keys and confirm KV hitrate >=0.8 before reattempt.
ops-oncall: reroute applied at 02:12 UTC, waiting on steady-state.
deploy-bot: US shadow reattempted 02:27 UTC -> metrics look good. Canary -> ramp -> full completed by 03:10 UTC.
maya: APAC wave started 03:05 UTC, finished 04:10 UTC with no major issues.
rachel: final release notes snippet: "Runtime v3.2.2 pinned globally; api feature token-streaming-v2 enabled; router header partitioning enabled; console schema v2.5 rolled with soft validator warnings for old clients. Notable: US shadow auto-throttle during transient backend DNS issue; no customer-facing incidents. Ops runbook updated with abort commands and throttle rules."
ev: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short postmortem for the auto-throttle event and a checklist to avoid future DNS flapping.
maya: excellent coordination. closing thread after post-check 20m. :white_check_mark:"
